items.title: Circle defends USDC economics as stablecoin rivals court its partners with bigger cut
items.snippet: Coinbase, Circle’s largest USDC partner, also backs Open USD, a rival network that passes reserve income to partners after a management fee.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо загального ринку -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.
